<style>
:root {

  --review-info: #eef6f8;

}

}

.main-container {
  max-width: 1600px !important;
  padding-bottom: 5rem;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, .title, .subtitle {
  color: var(--review-ink);
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}

.gallery-summary,
.review-checklist,
.review-callout,

  background: var(--review-paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--review-line);
}

.gallery-summary,
.review-checklist,

  margin: 1.25rem 0;
  padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
}

.review-callout {
  border-left-width: 6px;
}

.review-callout.warning {
  background: var(--review-warning);
  border-left-color: var(--review-warning-line);
}

.review-callout.info {
  background: var(--review-info);
  border-left-color: var(--review-info-line);
}

.review-checklist ul {
  columns: 2 28rem;
  column-gap: 2.5rem;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.review-checklist li {
  break-inside: avoid;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
  padding-left: 1.6rem;
  position: relative;
}

.review-checklist li::before {
  content: "\2610";
  left: 0;
  position: absolute;
  top: -0.05rem;
}

.figure-card {
  margin: 2rem 0 3rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem 1.4rem;
}

.figure-card h2 {
  border: 0;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
  padding: 0;
}

.figure-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.45rem 0.65rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.figure-meta span {
  background: #f4f4f4;
  border: 1px solid #d5d5d5;
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: #343434;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.45rem;
}

.figure-frame {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #d7d7d7;
  border-top: 1px solid #d7d7d7;

  padding: 1.25rem 0.2rem;

}

.figure-frame img {

  height: auto;

}

.figure-copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem 1.5rem;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 3fr) minmax(18rem, 2fr);
}

.figure-copy p {

}

.figure-copy .alt-text {

}

code {
  color: #252525;
  white-space: pre-wrap;

@media (max-width: 850px) {

```{r review-setup, echo=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
})

ROOT <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
FIGURE_DIR <- file.path(ROOT, "Publication", "figures")
MANIFEST_PATH <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "FIGURE_MANIFEST.csv")
AUXILIARY_MANIFEST_PATH <- file.path(
  FIGURE_DIR,
  "AUXILIARY_FIGURE_MANIFEST.csv"
)

figure_manifest <- read_csv(
  MANIFEST_PATH,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)
auxiliary_manifest <- read_csv(
  AUXILIARY_MANIFEST_PATH,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)

required_columns <- c(
  "figure_id", "basename", "width_mm", "height_mm", "final_font_family",
  "minimum_target_text_pt", "datasets", "release_status", "legend", "alt_text",
  "pdf", "png", "tiff"
)

if (!all(required_columns %in% names(figure_manifest))) {
  stop(
    "Figure manifest is missing required columns: ",
    paste(setdiff(required_columns, names(figure_manifest)), collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (nrow(figure_manifest) == 0L || anyDuplicated(figure_manifest$figure_id)) {
  stop("Figure manifest must contain unique, ordered figure records")
}
if (any(!is.finite(figure_manifest$width_mm)) || any(figure_manifest$width_mm <= 0)) {
  stop("Every figure must declare a positive final width")
}

source(file.path(ROOT, "scripts/publication/auxiliary_figure_contract.R"))
auxiliary_contract <- validate_auxiliary_figure_manifest(auxiliary_manifest)

figure_paths <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, figure_manifest$png)
if (any(!file.exists(figure_paths))) {
  stop(
    "Missing review PNG files: ",
    paste(basename(figure_paths[!file.exists(figure_paths)]), collapse = ", ")
  )
}
auxiliary_paths <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, auxiliary_manifest$png)
if (any(!file.exists(auxiliary_paths))) {
  stop(
    "Missing auxiliary review PNG files: ",
    paste(basename(auxiliary_paths[!file.exists(auxiliary_paths)]), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

maximum_width_mm <- max(figure_manifest$width_mm, auxiliary_manifest$width_mm)
figure_manifest$review_width_percent <-
  100 * figure_manifest$width_mm / maximum_width_mm
auxiliary_manifest$review_width_percent <-
  100 * auxiliary_manifest$width_mm / maximum_width_mm

escape_html <- function(value, attribute = FALSE) {
  htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(value), attribute = attribute)
}

format_inline <- function(value) {
  escaped <- escape_html(value)
  gsub("`([^`]+)`", "<code>\\1</code>", escaped, perl = TRUE)
}

figure_one <- figure_manifest[figure_manifest$figure_id == "Figure_1", , drop = FALSE]
figure_one_evidence <- if (nrow(figure_one) == 1L) {
  paste(
    figure_one$datasets,
    figure_one$legend,
    figure_one$alt_text,
    figure_one$basename,
    collapse = " "
  )
} else {
  ""
}
figure_1_has_phylogeny <- nrow(figure_one) == 1L && grepl(
  "S38|S39|phylogen|dated[ -]tree|time-calibrated",
  figure_one_evidence,
  ignore.case = TRUE,
  perl = TRUE
)

figure_two <- figure_manifest[
  figure_manifest$figure_id == "Figure_2",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
if (
  nrow(figure_two) != 1L ||
    !identical(figure_two$basename[[1]], "Figure_2_te_diversity_and_bonsai")
) {
  stop("Figure 2 does not use the canonical Bonsai figure basename")
}
figure_two_evidence <- paste(
  figure_two$datasets,
  figure_two$legend,
  figure_two$alt_text,
  collapse = " "
)
for (phrase in c("S42", "S43", "Bonsai", "not a species phylogeny", "feature resampling")) {
  if (!grepl(tolower(phrase), tolower(figure_two_evidence), fixed = TRUE)) {
    stop("Figure 2 is missing its Bonsai boundary phrase: ", phrase)
  }
}

```

<div class="gallery-summary">
This page is a visual-review surface, not a second figure authority. It reads
`Publication/figures/FIGURE_MANIFEST.csv` and
`Publication/figures/AUXILIARY_FIGURE_MANIFEST.csv` in row order and displays
the exact current review PNG for every record. Declared final widths are
preserved proportionally, so a 120-mm figure appears narrower than a 180-mm
figure.
</div>

```{r review-status, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "<p><strong>Current gallery:</strong> %d numbered or supplemental figures; ",
      "%d auxiliary review figures; widest declared figure: %.0f mm.</p>\n"
    ),
    nrow(figure_manifest),
    nrow(auxiliary_manifest),
    maximum_width_mm
  )
)

if (figure_1_has_phylogeny) {
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="review-callout info"><strong>Figure 1 is the integrated 21-species overview.</strong> ',
    'A topology-only species tree aligns reproductive strategy, conditional genome size, ',
    'dnaPipeTE composition, and low-divergence RepeatMasker signal in one fixed row order.</div>\n'
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="review-callout info"><strong>Figure 1 phylogeny status:</strong> ',
    'the current manifest does not yet declare an integrated phylogenetic overview. ',
    'This notice will change automatically when Figure 1 records that material.</div>\n'
  ))
}
```

<div class="review-callout warning">
<strong>Unresolved tree provenance.</strong> The source tree was supplied directly
by Alex Pyron, but its publication or archive identifier, calibration method, and
branch-length provenance remain unresolved. Numbered Figures 1, 4, and 5 therefore
show topology only. Supplied-time displays remain quarantined as auxiliary review
figures and are not independent validation of the calibration.
</div>

<div class="review-callout info">
<strong>Figure 2 Bonsai boundary.</strong> The rooted Bonsai Newick is a
TE-composition representation, not a species phylogeny; its display root has no
phylogenetic meaning. Reproductive strategy was annotated after initial PCA
review, and feature resampling perturbs correlated compositional coordinates
rather than resampling biological specimens. S09–S11 retain the PCA geometry as
a supplementary audit.
</div>

```{r integrated-history-boundary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="review-callout info"><strong>Wang-style integrated TE-history candidate boundary.</strong> %s <p>%s</p></div>\n',
  format_inline(auxiliary_manifest$boundary[[1]]),
  format_inline(auxiliary_manifest$legend[[1]])
))
```

<div class="review-callout info">
<strong>Wang-style TE-diversity candidate boundary.</strong> Conditional genome
sizes are assembly-anchored IOD-derived estimates. Reproductive-strategy panels
are post-hoc descriptive strata. The two direct developers are shown without a
regression because n = 2; the other six panels use Pagel-lambda PGLS fits.
</div>

<div class="review-callout info">
<strong>Cross-study TE-diversity boundary.</strong> Descriptive cross-study
context only; no pooled regression or hypothesis test. Wang et al. (2025)
values are the published top-10 TE-superfamily indices from Dryad (dataset DOI
<a href="https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.zpc866tkv">10.5061/dryad.zpc866tkv</a>;
article DOI
<a href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-025-08127-3">10.1038/s42003-025-08127-3</a>;
CC0-1.0), generated from RepeatModeler/RepeatMasker annotations. Current
<em>Desmognathus</em> top-10 indices are reclosed calculations from dnaPipeTE
compositions; the pipelines are different and not method-harmonized. Current
genome sizes are conditional <em>D. fuscus</em> assembly-anchored estimates,
not direct species C-values.
</div>

# Critique checklist

<div class="review-checklist">
<ul>
<li><strong>Narrative and material:</strong> Does every panel earn its place and support the intended manuscript claim?</li>
<li><strong>Cross-figure coherence:</strong> Do repeated concepts use the same visual grammar without implying false equivalence?</li>
<li><strong>Typography:</strong> Are font family, size, weight, italics, symbols, and panel tags consistent and legible at final size?</li>
<li><strong>Color:</strong> Are hues meaningful, high-contrast, color-vision accessible, and reinforced by shape or line type?</li>
<li><strong>Marks and uncertainty:</strong> Are points, lines, intervals, raw observations, and summary estimates visually distinct?</li>
<li><strong>Axes and labels:</strong> Are units, transformations, abbreviations, tick density, and scientific names clear?</li>
<li><strong>Spacing:</strong> Are gutters, panel proportions, margins, legend placement, and whitespace balanced?</li>
<li><strong>Reference-paper fit:</strong> Do framing, density, hierarchy, and annotation feel like one visual family?</li>
<li><strong>Legend and alt text:</strong> Can each figure be understood without manuscript body text?</li>
<li><strong>Phylogeny:</strong> Are topology, tip order, time direction, scale, and provenance boundary immediately clear?</li>
</ul>
</div>

# Figure gallery

```{r manifest-gallery, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (index in seq_len(nrow(figure_manifest))) {
  row <- figure_manifest[index, , drop = FALSE]
  figure_label <- gsub("_", " ", row$figure_id[[1]], fixed = TRUE)
  relative_png <- file.path("figures", row$png[[1]])
  width_percent <- row$review_width_percent[[1]]

  cat(
    sprintf(
      '<section class="figure-card" data-figure-id="%s">\n',
      escape_html(row$figure_id[[1]], attribute = TRUE)
    )
  )
  cat(sprintf("<h2>%s</h2>\n", escape_html(figure_label)))
  cat('<div class="figure-meta">\n')
  cat(sprintf(
    "<span>Final size: %.0f × %.0f mm</span>\n",
    row$width_mm[[1]],
    row$height_mm[[1]]
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<span>Font: %s</span>\n",
    escape_html(row$final_font_family[[1]])
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<span>Target text: ≥%g pt</span>\n",
    row$minimum_target_text_pt[[1]]
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<span>Datasets: %s</span>\n",
    escape_html(row$datasets[[1]])
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<span>Status: <code>%s</code></span>\n",
    escape_html(row$release_status[[1]])
  ))
  cat("</div>\n")

  cat('<div class="figure-frame">\n')
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<img src="%s" alt="%s" ',
      'style="width: %.3f%%; max-width: 100%%;" />\n'
    ),
    escape_html(relative_png, attribute = TRUE),
    escape_html(row$alt_text[[1]], attribute = TRUE),
    width_percent
  ))
  cat("</div>\n")

  cat('<div class="figure-copy">\n')
  cat(sprintf(
    '<p class="legend"><strong>Legend.</strong> %s</p>\n',
    format_inline(row$legend[[1]])
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    '<p class="alt-text"><strong>Alt text.</strong> %s</p>\n',
    format_inline(row$alt_text[[1]])
  ))
  cat("</div>\n</section>\n")
}
```

<div class="review-callout info">
Record critiques by figure ID and panel letter. Changes belong in the shared
ggplot theme or production figure builder, not in this gallery or its embedded
images.
</div>
